transcript: There are three phrases to say to yourself when anxiety begins to rise. They are not a spell, they are not a fight against the mind, they are a return. I am safe now, no danger now, body is here. Say them slowly, not to escape the future, not to correct the past. Anxiety lives in what has not arrived. Stillness lives only in this moment. When you repeat these phrases, the body softens, the breath deepens. The nervous system remembers there is no threat right now. You do not need to force calm, you only need to come back to where you already are. I am safe now, no danger now, body is here. If this practice speaks to you, you will find deeper guidance inside my new ebook, The Way Back to Stillness. The link is in my profile. Follow if you choose Stillness over Noise.
